mechanism: non-product two-row staggered periodic point set in the first two axes
periodic_points: (j*a1 + h*(k mod 2), k*s) for j,k in Z, with h=tau*a1; axes 3--5 have the ordinary s grid
period_cell: [0,a1] x [0,2s] x s^3 with two unit atoms and total mass 2
witnesses: all row-respecting l1 by l2 blocks and l3,l4,l5 in {1,...,4}; common r=(product l)^(1/5)/2; starts j,k=-6,...,6
normalization: tail reflections give factor 8, divided by period mass 2: ratio=4*absolute_union_volume
acceptance: exact dual union ratio strictly exceeds complete C algebraic value; then separate periodic collar/smoothing transfer is still required
